conversation.text: Hi, I have two things: my AC is blowing warm air and I want to get someone out, and I'd like to know if joining the maintenance plan would save me money on this.

Per the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md), Comfort Club members get priority scheduling, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on all service calls, 15% off all repairs (parts and labor), and no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls.
Members also get two seasonal tune-ups a year (one cooling, one heating) and annual reminder and filter-change notifications, and members get $500 off any full system replacement.
Standard is $189 per year or $16.99 per month, and Plus is $269 per year and adds a water heater flush and inspection, a whole-home plumbing inspection, and 15% off plumbing repairs.
